
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Thư gửi Trang</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Be+Vietnam+Pro:wght@300;400;500&family=Dancing+Script:wght@500;600&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* Night-lantern palette. The card is deliberately a fixed night scene in both light and dark viewers. */
  :root {
    --night: #0b1c19;
    --night-2: #17332c;
    --lantern: #f6c96e;
    --blush: #f5a6b8;
    --paper: #fffaf1;
    --ink: #3b2b2e;
    --text: #f1e6d8;
    --muted: #a9bdb1;
    --serif: "Playfair Display", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --hand: "Dancing Script", "Segoe Script", "Snell Roundhand", cursive;
    --sans: "Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    color-scheme: dark;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { --night: #0b1c19; }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] { --night: #0b1c19; }
  html { scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); }
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; }
  body {
    min-height: 100%;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%, var(--night-2) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(90% 50% at 50% 100%, #1d2a2a 0%, transparent 70%),
      var(--night);
    background-color: var(--night);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  html.locked, body.locked { overflow: hidden; height: 100%; }

  #bokeh { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ───────── Envelope stage ───────── */
  #stage {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 5;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    transition: opacity 1s ease;
  }
  #stage.gone { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .env-wrap { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 64px; padding-top: 14vh; }
  .env {
    position: relative; width: min(80vw, 340px); aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
    perspective: 1100px; cursor: pointer; outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .env:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lantern); outline-offset: 10px; border-radius: 12px; }
  .env > * { position: absolute; }
  .env-back {
    inset: 0; border-radius: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c8788d, #b35f78);
    box-shadow: 0 34px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.75), 0 0 90px rgba(246,201,110,.14);
  }
  .letter-card {
    left: 6%; right: 6%; top: 6%; height: 88%; z-index: 2;
    background: var(--paper); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start;
    padding-top: 9%; gap: 4px;
    transition: transform 1.15s cubic-bezier(.3,.75,.2,1) .7s;
  }
  .letter-card b { font: 600 clamp(26px, 8vw, 32px)/1.1 var(--hand); }
  .letter-card i { font-style: normal; color: #d0607c; font-size: 18px; }
  .pocket { inset: 0; z-index: 3; border-radius: 10px; }
  .pocket.l { background: #efbfbb; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 52% 54%, 0 100%); }
  .pocket.r { background: #f2c9c2; clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 48% 54%, 100% 100%); }
  .pocket.b { background: #f8dad0; clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 50% 48%, 100% 100%); }
  .flap {
    left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 58%; z-index: 4;
    transform-origin: 50% 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbe7de, #f2cdc6);
    clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%);
    border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
  }
  .seal {
    left: 50%; top: 58%; width: 54px; height: 54px; z-index: 6;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)) drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(246,201,110,.55));
    animation: beat 1.7s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .hint { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .02em; color: var(--muted); animation: breathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

  .env.open .seal { animation: pop .55s ease-out forwards; }
  .env.open .flap { animation: flap .85s .3s cubic-bezier(.4,.1,.2,1) forwards; }
  .env.open .letter-card { transform: translateY(-64%); }
  .env.open ~ .hint, .env-wrap.opened .hint { opacity: 0; animation: none; transition: opacity .4s; }

  @keyframes beat {
    0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
    12% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.14); }
    24% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
    36% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.09); }
    50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  }
  @keyframes pop {
    0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    35% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.55); opacity: 1; }
    100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(.2); opacity: 0; }
  }
  @keyframes flap {
    0% { transform: rotateX(0deg); z-index: 4; }
    49% { z-index: 4; }
    50% { z-index: 1; }
    100% { transform: rotateX(180deg); z-index: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: .45; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

  /* ───────── The letter ───────── */
  #letter[hidden] { display: none; }
  #letter {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 13vh 28px calc(16vh + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }
  h1.name {
    margin: 0; font: italic 500 clamp(46px, 15vw, 68px)/1.05 var(--serif);
    color: var(--lantern); letter-spacing: .005em;
  }
  h1.name span { display: inline-block; opacity: .1; }
  #letter.in h1.name span { animation: lit .9s ease-out forwards; }
  @keyframes lit {
    0% { opacity: .1; text-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(246,201,110,0); }
    35% { opacity: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 34px rgba(246,201,110,.95), 0 0 6px rgba(255,236,190,.9); }
    100% { opacity: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(246,201,110,.38); }
  }
  .squiggle { display: block; width: 168px; height: 14px; margin: 10px 0 18px 4px; overflow: visible; }
  .squiggle path { fill: none; stroke: var(--lantern); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 220; stroke-dashoffset: 220; opacity: .8; }
  #letter.in .squiggle path { animation: draw 1.4s 1.4s ease-out forwards; }
  @keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
  .lede { margin: 0; font-weight: 300; font-size: 17px; color: var(--muted); }

  .polaroid {
    position: relative; width: 90%; margin: 72px 0 34px;
    background: var(--paper); padding: 12px 12px 0; border-radius: 3px;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 50px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.85), 0 0 100px rgba(246,201,110,.09);
  }
  .polaroid.a { margin-right: auto; transform: rotate(-2.4deg); }
  .polaroid.b { margin-left: auto; transform: rotate(2.2deg); }
  .polaroid::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: -13px; left: 50%; width: 96px; height: 26px;
    background: rgba(246,201,110,.6); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-4deg);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  }
  .polaroid.b::before { background: rgba(245,166,184,.65); transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(3deg); }
  .polaroid img {
    display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 1px;
    filter: brightness(.12) saturate(0) blur(9px);
    transition: filter 2.8s ease .25s;
  }
  .polaroid.dev img { filter: none; }
  .polaroid figcaption { font: 500 24px/1.2 var(--hand); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; padding: 12px 8px 16px; }

  .fade { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 1.4s ease; }
  .fade.show { opacity: 1; }
  .body { margin: 0 0 1.3em; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.85; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text); text-wrap: pretty; }
  .closing { margin: 56px 0 8px; font: italic 500 clamp(24px, 7vw, 30px)/1.4 var(--serif); color: var(--blush); text-wrap: balance; }
  .sign { margin: 0 0 56px; font: 600 40px/1 var(--hand); color: var(--lantern); text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(246,201,110,.35); }

  .send {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer;
    padding: 15px 26px; border-radius: 999px;
    font: 400 16px/1 var(--sans); color: var(--text);
    background: rgba(246,201,110,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(246,201,110,.55);
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(246,201,110,.15), inset 0 0 20px rgba(246,201,110,.06);
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transition: background .3s, transform .15s;
  }
  .send:active { transform: scale(.97); }
  .send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lantern); outline-offset: 4px; }
  .send svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; }
  .tiny { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); opacity: .8; }

  .pop {
    position: fixed; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; line-height: 1;
    text-shadow: 0 0 12px currentColor; will-change: transform, opacity;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-delay: 0s !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; transition-delay: 0s !important; }
    .seal, .hint { animation: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body class="locked">
<canvas id="bokeh" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>

<main id="stage">
  <div class="env-wrap" id="envWrap">
    <div class="env" id="env" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Mở thư">
      <div class="env-back"></div>
      <div class="letter-card"><b>Gửi Trang</b><i>♥</i></div>
      <div class="pocket l"></div>
      <div class="pocket r"></div>
      <div class="pocket b"></div>
      <div class="flap"></div>
      <svg class="seal" id="seal" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe9a8"/><stop offset=".55" stop-color="#f6c96e"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#d99a3c"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <path fill="url(#gold)" d="M12 21.2 3.9 13.3C1.3 10.7 1.5 6.7 4.2 4.8c2.2-1.5 5-.9 6.6 1.1L12 7.3l1.2-1.4c1.6-2 4.4-2.6 6.6-1.1 2.7 1.9 2.9 5.9.3 8.5L12 21.2z"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <p class="hint">Chạm vào trái tim để mở thư</p>
  </div>
</main>

<article id="letter" hidden>
  <h1 class="name" id="name" aria-label="Gửi Trang,"></h1>
  <svg class="squiggle" viewBox="0 0 168 14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 8 C 14 1, 24 1, 36 8 S 58 15, 70 8 S 92 1, 104 8 S 126 15, 138 8 S 156 3, 166 7"/></svg>
  <p class="lede fade">một chút dịu dàng, dành riêng cho em</p>

  <figure class="polaroid a">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
